verses.1: Thus said Jehovah: “I will take a young man from the tribes of Israel, as well as from among the elders of the people and the priests.”
verses.2: And you went out to Geiy ben-Hinom, who was the one who opened the door of Harsit. You called out those words that I wanted to speak to you.
verses.3: And you said, “Hear the words of the LORD, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. As the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will bring evil upon this place, so that everyone who hears it will be terrified.”
verses.4: Because they abandoned me, and they desecrated this place. They sacrificed others to other gods. None of their ancestors, fathers, or kings of Judah knew about this. They filled this place with the blood of innocent people.
verses.5: And they built the altar for the man who would burn their children in fire. This was done by a man whom I did not command or tell to do this, and who did not even think of doing it.
verses.6: Therefore, see! Days are coming, says Jehovah. This place will no longer be called a “place of death.” Giey ben Hinoam is not worthy to be called a “killer.”
verses.7: And I will destroy the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place. Their leaders will be defeated before their enemies, and in the hands of those who seek to harm them. I will set their corpses at the food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.
verses.8: And I have given this city a name, and it will be a place of celebration and joy. All that happens there will be celebrated and honored there.
verses.9: And they will eat the flesh of their own children and the flesh of their own daughters. And anyone who eats the flesh of his neighbor’s child will be punished in the prison and in the pit that their enemies have prepared for them.
verses.10: And you have broken the seal in front of the eyes of those people who walk towards you.
verses.11: And you said to them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: I will destroy this people and this city, just as I destroyed all their gods. They will be buried in a place where there will be no more room for them.”
verses.12: So, I will do this to this place. May the LORD do so, and may those who dwell there be blessed. I will make this city completely destroyed.
verses.13: And there were those in the cities of Jerusalem and in the cities of the kings of Judah, who prepared impure offerings for all the gods of heaven. They offered sacrifices to other gods instead of offering them to God.
verses.14: And Jeremiah came from the place where Jehovah had sent him to be proclaimed. He stood in the court of the Temple and said to all the people:
verses.15: As Jehovah, the army of Israel’s God, says: “I will bring all the evil that I have spoken about against this city and all its inhabitants. For they have made things difficult for themselves, so that they cannot hear my words.”
